s01439.summary: Bookbindery staff work quietly; Liora asks Mateus for paste and Severine corrects them.
Mateus passes Liora the paste; their fingers touch and both glance away.
Liora and Mateus bicker over Odell's help while Severine deadpans.
Mateus quietly asks Liora to dinner; Severine overhears and dryly teases.

s01696.summary: Chloe carries her pie past rival Horace as the contest tent bustles.
Birdie calls Horace's pie dry, and he turns furious as Dolores urges calm.
Horace thrusts his tin forward and his filling splats on the floor; Birdie gloats.

s01533.summary: Dr. Emeka sits alone on the windy rooftop with coffee until Ilse joins him.
Emeka and Ilse quietly discuss tulips a husband brought to Mrs. Okoro.
Deshawn summons Emeka and his pager chirps, but he refuses to move.
Ilse presses Emeka about the scan until he admits it concerns Mrs. Okoro.
Emeka admits Mrs. Okoro asked about going home and he said only 'we would see'.
Emeka holds the door; they walk silently off the rooftop.

s00443.summary: Detective Hortense watches the nervous passengers at a stormy dinner table.
Lights flicker in a tunnel, a scream sounds, and Pruitt is found stabbed.
Hortense orders everyone still, examines the body, and sits Trevelyan down.
Greta says the knife was hers; Hortense notes the locked train and a liar among them.

s01124.summary: Bingo night in a church basement; regulars and a diocese visitor are introduced.
Rutendo demands the ledger from anxious Dov, who stalls until after the game.
Dov shouts, and Wilhelmina makes him look at her until he cracks.
Dov admits the roof money is gone, eleven thousand spent on his wife's treatments.
Anselm angrily calls Dov a thief while Candace defends the weeping man.
Wilhelmina gives the night's pot to Dov's wife; Anselm and Candace add money.
Rutendo promises the ledger will be called in order; the game resumes and Dov sits.

s01535.summary: Andreas stirs porridge and fusses over breakfast while Anneliese waits to leave.
Anneliese insists on the bus and clashes with Andreas about the calves and Jonas.
Anneliese shoulders her bag and heads for the door, whispering to herself.
Anneliese reveals she found ash from the mother's letters Andreas burned.
Andreas sees his wife's cardigan, orders her out, then tells her to go.
Anneliese tells him to eat the porridge and leaves; he eats from her spoon.

s00896.summary: Four people pleat dumplings in a steamy kitchen; Nonna critiques the filling.
Celeste and Rory pause as their fingers brush the flour.
Nonna Lucia says Rory is the man from Celeste's unsent letters; Celeste drops a dumpling.
Celeste leaves through the swinging door; Nonna Lucia tells Rory to sit and pleat.

s00389.summary: Funeral home staff prepare sandwiches and coffee while Agnes sits under the table.
Bart, Rosalind, Ngozi and Hector bicker over triangles and decaf coffee.
Ngozi asks Agnes what she is coloring; Agnes says Grandpa and a hush falls.
Agnes shows an orange drawing of Grandpa; Rosalind quietly completes forty sandwiches.

s00139.summary: Four teens sit in driving simulators; June grips the wheel nervously.
Mateo tips his chair to startle June, who brakes and swats him.
June reboots, drives smoothly, and shares a gummy worm with Greta.
Mateo floors the simulator into a crash and everyone laughs.
The grim instructor enters; the others point at Mateo for killing a school bus.

s01565.summary: Four people sit at a lone table in a rooftop greenhouse restaurant.
Lucretia tells Archie to move his knife away as Thad pushes for the papers.
Lucretia says Archie's vices cost her husband forty million and silences the table.
Isadora opens the window and takes her father's knife at Lucretia's bidding.
Lucretia demands the papers and Archie slides over an envelope.

s01911.summary: Garrick leads Hedda and Tick onto a creaking bridge of bones.
Something rattles beneath; the bridge lurches and the trio scrambles across.
They race to solid ground and collapse laughing and gasping.

s02369.summary: Nova wheels a laundry cart into the counting room and counts towels.
Felix doubts her story about the lobby fountain and eyes the phone.
Nova pulls out a black cylinder and stalks closer as the camera turns red.
The cylinder is only a flashlight; Nova laughs and wheels out as the vault opens.

s00085.summary: Kalinda pries open a hidden compartment and finds a velvet satchel.
Headlights sweep the window; the crew freezes until the beam passes.
The satchel is light, holding only a key and a note about the third horse.
Kalinda unlocks the third horse and gold coins pour out.
A siren sounds and the thieves scatter and hide as the doors burst open.

s00788.summary: A crew waits in the cheese vault while Junior cracks the safe.
Marguerite wipes her fingerprint from a cheese rind and orders gloves.
A man in a white apron with a cheese iron challenges the thieves.
Bertrand reveals he guarded the wheel forty years; it holds his wife's memory.
Marguerite proposes splitting the wheel and he agrees with a handshake.
The safe opens revealing the dark wheel; they toast the wife with a thermos.

s00031.summary: A janitor mops near the vault door while a guard scrolls a tablet.
The guard hears a tap and questions the janitor's name.
Dwyer tasers the guard and takes his keycard.
Aurelio steps from the shadows, banters with Dwyer, and opens the vault.

s01609.summary: Five ranch hands sit silently on the porch at dusk.
Hank shares half an apple with Tobias; Cleo sniffs the air for rain.

s00500.summary: Cornelius sells a painting's impeccable provenance over tea; Philippa stays tense.
As Cornelius starts to sign, Detective Anselm enters and says he's been listening.
Philippa reveals a wire, and Cornelius lunges, is restrained, and the painting is exposed.
The painting is shown to be a forgery.

s01373.summary: A boat poles through a flooded cathedral carrying a covered birdcage.
Nerissa and Barnaby bicker as the caged creature stirs and Odalys warns it's awake.
The water stirs near the pulpit and something enormous turns beneath the boat.
Barnaby begs Odalys to give up the bird; she refuses as the boat lifts.
Odalys uncovers the cage and the wren's note stills the water.

s01933_1.summary: Six relatives crowd an ice-fishing hut, bickering over a fish and muskrat.
A tug on Nana's line stills everyone and they urge her to pull.
Nana hauls up a pike that lands in Beatriz's lap, causing chaos.
Sione takes over from Arjun, frees the hook, and everyone cheers.

s02159.summary: Gunnar sets out rations while Paloma checks Reggie's cold hands.
Base warns by radio that the storm will last seventy-two hours.
Reggie asks about cards and Gunnar takes off his cap to deal.

s01512.summary: Legal aid staff gather in a former dentist's suite with their client.
Olivia questions Harold about rent receipts, which he keeps as carbons in his freezer.
Olivia reveals the eviction notice names the wrong tenant, Harold's dead brother.

s01875.summary: Bastien cycles up to Kes lying on a car hood at the abandoned drive-in.
Willow and Bastien call Kes out for lateness and a broken driving promise.
Willow asks if this is about Dad; Kes deflects, talking about movies on the screen.
Kes sits up and lets Willow take the wheel.

s02447.summary: Luz slams combinations into Bernard's pads while he silently demands more.
Kofi climbs in, Bernard orders three rounds, and Luz and Kofi begin circling.

s00385.summary: Nasrin holds a valve in the control cage while injured Joseph lies on the floor.
Nasrin reports to Orbital that the drill hit something that rang like a bell.
Joseph grips her ankle and warns her not to pull the bit as pressure spikes.
Gauges drop to zero and a pale blue light rises through the grating.

s01507.summary: Four coworkers panic in an escape room as the clock counts down.
Coworkers bicker over lateness while Norman suggests the skull is the key.
Norman finds a key taped inside the skull and opens the chest.
The chest card congratulates them and asks for lanyards back.

s01475_0.summary: Three exhausted soldiers wade through a flooded sugar mill.
The Medic stumbles; the Sergeant steadies him while the Captain waits.

s02221.summary: Dot, Fitz and Gunny's slapstick sends the birthday cake down Lane 6.
They panic over the ruined cake and Fitz grumbles about his shark costume.
Gunny retrieves the cake and vows to fix it despite having no spatula.
Pru announces Kevin is stuck on the phone with his mother, giving them time.

s00372_0.summary: June laces a skate after closing as Mr. Dubois urges everyone to leave.
Rafa, Priya and Calvin pressure June, saying their mother waits in the car.
Priya and Rafa both offer to go with June, who gives a small laugh.
June skates one last lap under the disco ball.
June returns the skates and leaves with Priya's bag of chips.
